properties.summary: Nevada Power Company (NEVP), which balances southern Nevada, reported 0 MW of demand to EIA for the hour to 07:00 UTC 20 Nov 2026, against its day-ahead forecast of 4,017 MW. Its demand usually runs at 109% of its forecast (the median of the 168 hours before), so about 4,377 MW was expected: 100% below. Demand stayed 25% or more below that for 20 hours in a row, 06:00 UTC 20 Nov 2026 to 02:00 UTC 21 Nov 2026, about 89,540 MWh less than expected. A gap like this fits customers losing power (a storm, strikes on the grid, a failure) and also a forecast miss, batteries charging or a reporting error; EIA-930 figures are preliminary and balancing authorities correct them within days. Reported by the balancing authority to EIA; Blackout measures the gap and does not assess the cause. Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration (21 Nov 2026).
properties.title: Nevada Power Company: demand 100% below what its forecast implies, 20 h (EIA-930)
